# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] <project-slug>: <Short Project Title>`
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/<project-slug>/`
> **Mandatory Next Step:** After opening this PR, submit the PR URL through the official Google Form: **[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**.

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** AEGIS — AI Evidence Grounding & Integrity System
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/aegis-ai-safety/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** AEGIS verifies research claims against the actual source document and returns page-level supporting or conflicting evidence. It stores documents, passages, sessions, claims, results, and evidence links in IBM Db2 and abstains when the evidence is absent, noncomparable, or out of scope.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** LLM-assisted literature review can confidently repeat claims that the cited paper never made. AEGIS gives researchers, students, and review teams an auditable verification step with exact passage provenance instead of ungrounded plausibility judgments.

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** Db2 Community Edition 12.1.5, run locally in a Podman container (`aegis-db2`, port 50000, database `TESTDB`).
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Db2 is the primary store and retrieval source. `DOCUMENTS` and page-level `PASSAGES` hold uploaded evidence; `VERIFICATION_SESSIONS`, `CLAIMS`, `VERIFICATION_RESULTS`, and `EVIDENCE_LINKS` hold the full audit trail. Lexical retrieval queries `PASSAGES` joined to `DOCUMENTS`; every classification and evidence link is written back in the same request lifecycle. History, evidence inspection, and JSON/Markdown exports are reconstructed from Db2.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** IBM `ibm_db` with prepared statements (`prepare` + `bind_param` + `execute`) and explicit transactions.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** Schema `AEGIS`; six relational tables with foreign keys/cascades, unique and check constraints, identity columns, CLOB/VARCHAR text, indexes, joins, parameterized SQL, and rollback. The schema is applied idempotently by `database/init_db.py`.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:**
  1. Start Db2 and run `make db-init`.
  2. Start the API and call `GET /api/db/health` (connected, six tables).
  3. Upload a PDF with `POST /api/documents`.
  4. Run `POST /api/verify` with selected document IDs.
  5. Open `GET /api/verifications/{id}` and `GET /api/verifications/{id}/export`.
  6. Run `AEGIS_TEST_DB2=1 pytest tests/test_integration_db2.py -v` (2 passed).

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.11, TypeScript, JavaScript
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS, PyMuPDF, IBM `ibm_db`, LangChain
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** LangChain (`ChatPromptTemplate | ChatOpenAI | StrOutputParser`)
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** Local Ollama `qwen2.5:7b-instruct` for reported results; any OpenAI-compatible provider is configurable.
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** LangChain extracts atomic claims, then verifies each claim against only the top Db2-retrieved passages and returns structured JSON with cited passage IDs. Deterministic guards validate citations, numeric consistency, and abstention cases; model/provider failure becomes `VERIFICATION_ERROR`, never false support.

---

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/aegis-ai-safety/README.md` and `submissions/aegis-ai-safety/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/aegis-ai-safety/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested on the development machine; production build and the smoke test pass.
- [x] **License Declared:** Application code is MIT licensed; SciFact dataset rights remain with its authors (CC BY-NC 2.0).
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository Code of Conduct.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds `submissions/aegis-ai-safety/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [ ] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form (**[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**).

---

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- **Public experience:** Vercel HTTPS showcase, clearly labelled “Demo” and “Interactive demonstration”; desktop/mobile verified with no console errors or horizontal overflow. Full live verification remains local because no hosted Db2/inference is configured.
- **Reported results, with scope:** SciFact macro F1 **0.678**, accuracy **0.700**, contradiction precision/recall **0.714 / 0.500**, Recall@5 **0.76**, Recall@10 **0.77** on a 100-claim development subset selected without gold labels. This is not the hidden test split and not general accuracy.
- **Controlled suite:** 40/40 on a small hand-written 3-paper set. This is not a benchmark and should not be presented as general accuracy.
- **Hallucination suite:** 10/10 controlled cases.
- **Final smoke test:** BERT PDF ingested; 3 claims returned 1 SUPPORTED / 1 CONTRADICTED / 1 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, 0 errors; JSON and Markdown exports generated; session #741 persisted in Db2.
- **Checks:** backend 64 passed / 2 skipped; real-Db2 integration 2 passed; evaluation utilities 9 passed; frontend typecheck, lint, and production build pass; GitHub Actions backend and frontend pass.
- **Submission validation:** `python scripts/validate_submission.py submissions/aegis-ai-safety` → ALL VALIDATION CHECKS PASSED.
- **Known limitations:** contradiction recall remains the main SciFact weakness; the local 7B model is slow; no vector retrieval, authentication, or hosted deployment. See `README.md` and `architecture.md` in this submission.
- **Source code:** full AEGIS source is included under `src/`; the separate main repository remains at https://github.com/sakethdonepudi/aegis-ai-safety.
